search_notes: COMPEL, WCLC 2025 oral OA08.03 (meeting 6-9 Sept 2025; OncLive coverage dated 6 Sept, ILCN and ASCO Post 8 Sept say presented Monday 8 Sept; ESMO Open paper PMID 41139117 dated 8 Sept 2025). Median PFS 8.4 vs 4.4 mo, HR 0.43 (95% CI 0.27-0.70), no p-value anywhere (registry results posted 2026-01-13 give the same HR with a log-rank method but no p-value). Enrolment stopped early at 98 patients because of the changed treatment landscape and ILCN reports the study as underpowered to statistically assess the primary endpoint; no source says 'met', so primary_result is unclear although the interval excludes 1 (arguably met). Not in AstraZeneca's Q1 2025 clinical trials appendix; no press release found.

INSPIRE (name given after registration; WX-0593 = iruplinalkib). Prespecified interim analysis (145 of 192 planned IRC PFS events, cutoff 13 Nov 2022) presented at WCLC 2023, abstract OA03.05 (meeting 9-12 Sept 2023; OncLive coverage dated 10 Sept, Oncology Nursing News 11 Sept): median PFS 27.7 vs 14.6 mo, HR 0.344 (0.226-0.523), p<0.0001. The JTO paper (PMID 38280448, online 2024-01-25) reports the interval as a 98.02% CI 0.23-0.52. Win at interim with trial continuing, coded met. Registry record stale (status unknown, last update Nov 2023, estimated completion 2024-12-01). Qilu is unlisted; an earlier Chinese-language notice (first-line approval in China followed in early 2024) was not searched for after the web-search budget ran out.

No result found. One web search by drug names (QL1706, iparomlimab and tuvonralimab) and indication returned only the registry record and phase 1/2 data; PubMed (QL1706 OR iparomlimab AND nasopharyngeal) has only phase 1/1b papers. Registry not updated since Nov 2023 (status unknown, 460 planned). Qilu is unlisted, so no exchange filings exist. Chinese-language and conference searches were not run (web-search budget exhausted).

No result found. Registry shows not yet recruiting (last update Aug 2024) with an estimated primary completion date of 2024-12-31 that cannot be the phase 3 PFS analysis of a 606-patient trial; two primaries (ORR for the phase 2 part, PFS for phase 3). PubMed (linperlisib AND CHOP / PTCL) has only relapsed-setting and combination phase 1 papers. Shanghai YingLi is not on the Hong Kong exchange. No general web search was run (budget exhausted).

Primary analysis presented at ESMO 2025 (17-21 Oct 2025, Berlin), abstract 2987O: median PFS 12.8 vs 3.7 mo, HR 0.38 (0.25-0.57), p<0.001. Earliest dated source opened is Targeted Oncology, 22 Oct 2025; the session day was not confirmed and the abstract text was probably online about a week earlier. Novartis Q1, Q2 and Q3 2025 interim financial reports and investor presentations were downloaded and searched: no mention of this trial. Registry results posted 2026-05-22 give the same HR; Lancet Oncology paper followed in 2026. No Novartis press release found.

HARMONi-6 (AK112-306). Akeso HKEX voluntary announcement published 07:45 on 23 Apr 2025 (PR Newswire copy datelined Hong Kong, 22 Apr): IDMC declared PFS met at the first prespecified interim analysis, no numbers. Akeso's FY2024 results (30 Mar 2025) said only that enrolment was complete. HR 0.60 (0.46-0.78), p<0.0001 first shown at the ESMO 2025 Presidential Symposium with simultaneous Lancet publication (coverage dated 19 Oct 2025; Akeso HKEX notice 20 Oct). OS (key secondary) later met, HR 0.66, ASCO 2026.

Not read out as far as can be told. SUNHO Bio (HKEX 2898) 2025 interim results (29 Aug 2025) say the phase IIb/III trial of IAH0968 plus CAPEOX in first-line HER2+ colorectal cancer was entered in January 2024, with no result. Nothing later: the company has not published 2025 annual or 2026 interim results and its shares have been suspended since 1 Apr 2026. PubMed has only the phase 1 paper. Registry stale (status unknown, Feb 2024). No general web search run (budget exhausted).

which_endpoint: DFS (durvalumab + BCG induction and maintenance vs BCG)
search_notes: POTOMAC. AstraZeneca high-level results release of 9 May 2025: statistically significant DFS improvement for the induction-plus-maintenance arm, no numbers. AstraZeneca's Q1 2025 results and clinical trials appendix (29 Apr 2025) still listed the readout as anticipated in H1 2025. HR 0.68, p=0.0154 first shown at ESMO 2025 (LBA108) with Lancet publication online 17 Oct 2025; earliest coverage opened is Urology Times, 18 Oct, which gives no CI. CI 0.50-0.93 is in AstraZeneca's 9M 2025 results (6 Nov 2025). US approval May 2026; EU application withdrawn July 2026.

which_endpoint: Hierarchical all-cause mortality and CV hospitalisation (win ratio)
search_notes: CAEL101-301 (Mayo stage IIIb; CAEL-101 = anselamimab; CARES programme with sibling CAEL101-302, NCT04512235). AstraZeneca release of 16 Jul 2025 names both registry numbers: the primary endpoint was not statistically significant in the overall population across both trials; a prespecified subgroup (later identified as kappa isotype) showed benefit. Repeated in the H1 2025 results (29 Jul 2025) as 'Primary endpoint not met'; Q1 2025 appendix had data anticipated H2 2025. The endpoint is a win ratio, so no hazard ratio applies and the HR cells are blank. Trial-level result for this registry number posted 2026-07-02: win ratio 0.95 (0.61-1.48), p=0.777. Placebo-controlled; not a time-to-event HR design.

ETER100 (TQB2450 = benmelstobart). Sino Biopharmaceutical HKEX voluntary announcement of 23 May 2024: IDMC found PFS by independent imaging review met the predefined superiority threshold at the protocol interim analysis, no numbers; CDE agreed to a filing (accepted 1 Aug 2024). HR 0.53 (0.42-0.67), p<0.0001 presented at ESMO 2024 (LBA76); the company's HKEX notice with the HR is dated 16 Sep 2024, trade coverage 17 Sep. Registry still shows an estimated primary completion date of 2025-06 (month only, taken as the 15th) and was last updated Oct 2024.

IMvigor011. First disclosure found is the release of the collaborator Natera, 18 Aug 2025: statistically significant DFS and OS improvement, no numbers. No Roche release of that date found; Roche's half-year 2025 release and slides (24 Jul 2025) were opened and carry no result, and the Q3 2025 slides (23 Oct) list it as a positive Q3 readout. HR 0.64 (0.47-0.87), p=0.0047 at ESMO 2025 with NEJM publication; Roche release dated 20 Oct 2025 (Genentech copy 19 Oct US time). Registry results posted 2026-09-28 match.

Terminated with 16 patients enrolled. Registry 'why stopped' (record updated 2026-02-20): Telix is running a separate phase 3, ProstACT Global (NCT06520345), under an IND, which 'necessitates the closure of the current 177Lu-TLX591-002 Phase 3 trial'. No efficacy analysis of this protocol found; Telix news about ProstACT Global Part 1 (2026) concerns the other registration. Source: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04876651.

which_endpoint: PFS (investigator) in ITT and ESR1m, co-primary
search_notes: evERA. Roche release of 22 Sep 2025: both co-primary endpoints met, no numbers. Roche half-year 2025 slides (24 Jul 2025) still listed the readout as a 2025 outlook item. Numbers in the Roche release of 18 Oct 2025 for ESMO 2025: ITT HR 0.56 (0.44-0.71), ESR1m HR 0.38 (0.27-0.54), both p<0.0001; HR cells hold the ITT value. NEJM paper 1 Oct 2026.

FURVENT (furmonertinib = firmonertinib). ArriVent release of 6 Oct 2026 (8-K exhibit 99.1): did not meet PFS by BICR; 240 mg vs chemotherapy HR 0.75 (0.55-1.02), p=0.0654 (in the HR cells); 160 mg HR 0.91 (0.67-1.25). Three-arm trial. Guidance had moved from 2025 to early 2026 to mid-2026; no earlier 8-K between March and October 2026 carries a result (filing list checked, earlier exhibits not opened). Registry estimated date 2025-08-15, not updated since June 2025.

REFRaME-O1 (STRO-002 = luveltamab tazevibulin). Sutro announced on 13 Mar 2025 that it would deprioritise luvelta after a portfolio review (10-Q for Q1 2025, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1382101/000095017025067072/stro-20250331.htm); registry: terminated for strategic business considerations, not safety or efficacy. No PFS analysis of the randomised phase 3 part was reported; the 32% response rate of Dec 2024 was from the dose-optimisation part (seen in a search summary only). Registry lists 600 as actual enrolment, which looks like the planned figure.

No result found. PubMed (CinnaGen AND cetuximab; cetuximab biosimilar AND Iran AND colorectal) returns nothing for this trial. Registry stale (status unknown, last update Apr 2023, estimated completion 2025-11-30). Biosimilar equivalence design, to be reviewed for exclusion. No general web search, Persian-language search or Iranian registry (IRCT) check was run (budget exhausted).

AK105-304. No topline announcement exists: all Akeso (2023-2026) and Sino Biopharm (mid-2023 to Apr 2025) HKEX titles were listed and none reports this trial's result. The earliest explicit statement found is the FDA approval notice of 23 Apr 2025: median PFS 9.6 vs 7.0 mo, HR 0.45 (0.33-0.62), p<0.0001 (prespecified interim analysis); presented at AACR 2025 (CT011) days later. HINTS THAT PREDATE IT, without stating a result: Akeso FY2023 results (18 Mar 2024) say an sNDA for first-line NPC was submitted in Dec 2023; NMPA approval announced 16 Mar 2025. An adjudicator may prefer one of those dates. Registry still gives an estimated primary completion of 2026-02-23.

CSPC FY2025 results (25 Mar 2026) list albumin-bound docetaxel for advanced pancreatic cancer among pipeline products with no result; the 2026 interim results (20 Aug 2026) do not mention the pancreatic trial. STOP-PC. Not read out. Oncotelic's 10-Q for Q2 2026 (filed 13 Aug 2026; first 100,000 characters read) says OT-101 is out-licensed to a joint venture that 'continues preparing for planned Phase 2 and Phase 3 trials' in pancreatic cancer and other indications; no enrolment or result for this trial. PubMed: nothing. Registry stale (recruiting, Aug 2024, 455 planned). No general web search run (budget exhausted).

KEYNOTE-676. No result found by two web searches (acronym, Merck, pembrolizumab plus BCG). Merck's Q2 2026 earnings release (4 Aug 2026, 8-K exhibit) and the first ten items of its news page (to 1 Oct 2026) do not mention the trial; the pipeline page (as of 5 Aug 2026) does not list NMIBC among selected Keytruda trials. Registry: active, not recruiting, estimated primary completion 2026-07-31, updated May 2026. Two primaries in separate cohorts (CR rate in cohort A, EFS in cohort B). ASPIRE (SBP-101 = ivospemin). No result found. Panbela's last results release (14 Nov 2024) said the interim analysis was on track for Q1 2025; the company notified its lender of default on 20 Jan 2025, filed its last 8-K on 18 Feb 2025 and has made no SEC filing since (an SEC staff order is dated 29 Sep 2025). Company website refused the connection. PubMed has only 2026 case reports of retinal toxicity. Registry stale (recruiting, Nov 2024). The interim outcome may have been announced outside EDGAR in 2025; no general web search was run (budget exhausted).

PACIFIC-9. Not read out. AstraZeneca H1 2026 clinical trials appendix: 'Data anticipated: H2 2026'; not mentioned among readouts in the H1 2026 results announcement. Partner Innate Pharma's H1 2026 release (17 Sep 2026) expects the readout by year-end. Two web searches found nothing. Registry estimated primary completion 2026-09-30.

HARMONi-GI1 (AK112-309; acronym assigned after registration). Akeso HKEX voluntary announcement of 26 Aug 2026: IDMC declared OS met at a prespecified interim analysis, with PFS and ORR key secondaries also met; no numbers, detailed results to be presented at a conference.
